We had a good meal at Acre Bengaluru after arriving in Bangalore this weekend.

The beer was quite good, along with the pinacolada.

The starters were yum- we loved the falafel hummus, pepper chicken and the chili chicken.

The chicken biryani was a bit spicy for our liking, but the flavours were bang on 😍

The ambience was good, but the food was extremely disappointing. The food contained excessive oil, and the quality of the oil seemed very poor, which upset our health.

The curries they served were overloaded with coriander seeds, making us difficult to eat. The taste was completely disappointing, and the overall food quality was nowhere near what we expected.

To make matters worse, most of the items listed on the menu were not available, leaving us with very limited options. The entire experience was not worth the money at all. It felt like a complete waste of money.

Despite the good ambience, the poor food quality, excessive oil, curries overloaded with coriander, and lack of menu availability made this a very unpleasant experience. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service provided yesterday (31.08.2026)

All of our guests, thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance, cuisine, and service.

I particularly value Mr Santosh's meticulous attention to detail, especially in ensuring that each course was served promptly and with appropriate intervals.

The mushroom soup was highly acclaimed, and the Caesar salad, a dish for which I have particularly high standards given my extensive experience in the United States, notably New York, significantly surpassed my expectations.

The appetizers were flavorful and perfectly spiced. The garlic naan and gravy were excellent, as were the Hakka noodles.

Thank you Mr Santosh and Acre for your thoughtful care of our guests. We had a truly wonderful experience yesterday, and I also extend my gratitude to Inder for his attentive service.

We will enthusiastically recommend Acre to our associates.

It was a truly memorable and delightful evening. Thank you.

⭐️ 1-Star Review – Very Disappointing Experience

We visited Acre Bar & Restaurant on Sunday with our group and had a very disappointing experience.

Our total bill was ₹41,133. After making the payment at around 9:45 PM, the staff’s behaviour became very unprofessional. We were not given proper answers to our questions, and the staff did not respond respectfully.

One staff member, Rakesh, was also giving incorrect information regarding another staff member’s name, which created unnecessary confusion.

We were also expecting music/DJ entertainment, but there was no DJ or proper music today (Sunday). When we asked about it, we did not receive a proper response.

For a restaurant where customers are spending ₹41,133, we expected much better service, communication, and behaviour from the staff. Unfortunately, the experience after payment was particularly disappointing.

Management should seriously look into the staff behaviour and customer service. Paying a high bill does not mean customers should be treated without proper respect or attention.

Overall: Very disappointing service and behaviour. I would not recommend this experience.
